messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the backward-compat approach for the v2 route rollout. High-level proposal:
- Keep v1 behavior by default for N months via routing/headers
- Offer a runtime shim (X-RI-Compat: v1) that maps v1 payloads to v2 shape where possible
- Make structured-output strict mode opt-in (breaking by default)
- Clear deprecation timeline + migration checklist for customers

Need concrete acceptance criteria and an actionable migration guide. Thoughts?

Sam (Eng): I like the shim idea but prefer a shorter compat window if we can auto-shim reliably. @Mike: can runtime do header-based translation without huge perf hit?

Mike (Infra): We can implement header-based translation at the routing layer for chat/completions/embeddings. Tool/function calling is trickier — signature and arg encoding changed (positional -> kwargs), so shim is possible but lossy in some edge cases. Performance hit estimate: +5–15% p95 depending on batching.

Julie (Customer Success): FYI we have three enterprise customers asking to remain on v1 for at least 9 months. One customer requires stable reranking logits — shim likely won't guarantee bit-exact outputs.

Anya (PM): Good context. So tradeoffs: reliability for customers vs long-running maintenance burden. I want to finalize: (a) minimal invariants we must preserve; (b) set of changes that are allowed only via explicit opt-in; (c) per-customer windows + SLOs.

Sam (Eng): Minimal invariants proposal:
- Prompt token ordering preserved
- EOS / end-of-stream markers unchanged
- Tool-call invocation format preserved when X-RI-Compat set
- Embedding vector dimension and normalization stable
Anything else we should lock?

Mike (Infra): Add: routing must support canary + instant fallback to v1 route. We should surface a telemetry flag for regression deltas and tie it to the rollout gate. We can reuse the existing route fallback mechanism; need tests for shim under load.

Anya (PM): Draft launch criteria (initial):
1) Public migration guide + code samples + SDK helpers for compat header
2) Shim prototype exercised in perf tests (p95 latency within SLO)
3) E2E regression evals show <X% delta on quality metrics for beta customers
4) At least two customers committed to beta cutover
5) Runbook + rollback playbook documented

Julie (Customer Success): Also add customer comms checklist: legal & data export notice, scheduled cutover windows, test harness for customers, and explicit opt-out token so they can stay pinned to v1 if needed.

Sam (Eng): Edge-case callout: function/tool calling with multi-turn KV-cached args can change behavior when we convert arg formats; mark tool-calls as "incompatible by default" unless compat header present. We'll need metrics: function-call success rate, false-positive tool invocations, and average latency.

Anya (PM): OK. Action items from this thread:
- @Sam: prototype shim mapping for tool calls + mapping doc (due EOD Fri)
- @Mike: add telemetry flag, wire up canary fallback + run load tests (due next Tue)
- @Julie: reach out to the 3 enterprise accounts to schedule beta windows and confirm requirements (due EOD Thu)
- @Anya: draft migration guide + checklist and post for review by Mon

infra-bot: deploybot: created branch compat/shim-proto, build started — CI will post results here.

Sam (Eng): ACK, I'll include a README in the PR with mapping examples and a small `curl` shim example that shows header usage.

Julie (Customer Success): Will PM the customers and try to get two for beta. I'll also capture any legal constraints re: deprecation notice length.

Anya (PM): Thanks all — I'll spin up the doc and a short migration checklist. We can use this thread as the source of truth for action-item status. :thumbsup:
